🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION — Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; defensive Healthcare leadership vs broad sector strength creates mixed signals. Confirmations: Healthcare stocks (ABBV, JNJ, LLY) ABOVE TREND while Technology is weak, so reduce tempo and be selective.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate/Utilities follow with WELL (1W: +10.01% | 1M: +6.14%) ABOVE TREND and utility group showing constructive breadth.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -19.40% | 1M: -22.22%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary and Materials also weak (NKE and DOW among the worst).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Healthcare) — concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: DOW (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -14.95%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -1.85%) BELOW TREND, NKE (1W: -9.85% | 1M: -10.58%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -20.41%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Tech/Materials and select Financial names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Largest 1W movers: ABBV (1W: +17.03%), MRK (1W: +12.99%), JNJ (1W: +11.50%). No major divergence signal in short-term momentum aside from narrow Healthcare leadership — treat moves as tactical, not broad market confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.62%) with major names below trend: NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.69% | 1M: -9.62%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -13.18%) BELOW TREND; IBM (1W: +9.04% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND is a lone outlier. Sector outlook: negative-to-neutral until tech breadth improves.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed but stable (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +4.33%); leaders JPM (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +9.95%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.75% | 1M: +2.63%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.88% | 1M: +0.80%) ABOVE TREND. Watch for earnings/news to determine follow-through; breadth supportive but not leading.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is dominant (1W: +7.10% | 1M: +7.05%) with broad strength: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +6.72% | 1M: +12.06%) ABOVE TREND. Sector outlook: constructive but leadership concentration warrants caution.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Healthcare exposure (ABBV, JNJ, LLY, UNH) and selective Real Estate/Utilities while reducing exposure to large-cap Technology names showing BELOW TREND (NVDA, AAPL, MSFT). Style: Defensive/Healthcare favored given narrow leadership; be selective where breadth is thin.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed; LLY (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND — EMA catalyst confirmed; MRK (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -19.40% | 1M: -22.22%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +7.10% | 1M: +7.05%) — clear leader; Real Estate and Utilities showing support. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.62%), Consumer Discretionary and Materials under pressure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: watch short-term support zone around recent lows for trend confirmation (below-weekly breakdown risks broader tech weakness). AAPL: monitor 1W pacing — continued closes below recent support would keep it BELOW TREND. JPM: sustained push above recent highs (1M-positive momentum) would reinforce Financials ABOVE TREND continuation. ABBV: follow-through above recent gap would confirm accumulation after bullish catalyst.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ABBV (+75): Health Canada approval; ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND — price confirms sentiment. LLY (+80): EMA backing for Jaypirca; LLY (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned. MA (+60): merchant-fee settlement progress; MA (1W: +1.88% | 1M: +0.80%) ABOVE TREND — watch for pickup in volume.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (-60): CFO departure/clinical miss headline; PFE (1W: -3.65% | 1M: -7.33%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. MSFT (-55): negative narrative on recent weakness; MSFT (1W: -1.69% | 1M: -9.62%) BELOW TREND — price confirming. AAPL (-50): AI concerns headline; AAPL (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND — watch for distribution.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, Defensive/Healthcare favored given narrow leadership and strong sector headlines. ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow Healthcare concentration vs broad Tech weakness (NVDA, AAPL, MSFT BELOW TREND) — monitor sentiment-confirmation and breadth for regime shift.
